items.q: Koi purani theme toh nahi chipkaoge?
items.a: Bilkul nahi. Har design Figma mein custom banta hai aur code aapka rehta hai.
Haan, har fixed build mein 30 days ka free post-launch support included hai.

items.q: Ad budget alag kyun hota hai?
items.a: Taaki 100% transparency rahe — ad spend seedha aapke Meta/Google card se jaata hai.

items.q: Website quotes alag-alag kyun hote hain?
items.a: Pages, custom motion, CRM sync aur bilingual copy hours decide karte hain.

items.q: Diagnostic pehle lena zaroori kyun hai?
items.a: 7–10 day audit leaks pehle pakadta hai taaki dev aur ads budget waste na ho.

items.q: Kya Hindi aur Hinglish campaigns likhte ho?
items.a: Haan, hum Jaipur aur pan-India buyers ke liye natural bilingual hooks likhte hain.
